title: Human Pharmacokinetic Prediction of Antibody-Drug Conjugates Using Human FcRn Transgenic Mice.
caption: Mean ± SD plasma concentration–time profiles of ADCs in Tg32 mice. Open squares indicate total ADC concentration‐time profiles and closed squares indicate total antibody concentration‐time profiles.
context: Mean ± SD plasma concentration–time profiles of ADCs in Tg32 mice. Open squares indicate total ADC concentration‐time profiles and closed squares indicate total antibody concentration‐time profiles. As shown in Figures 1 and 2 , all ADCs exhibited biphasic elimination profiles for both total antibody and total ADC.
